boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 46 has three boss chambers across the upper half — two smaller ones at `3` each and a larger one at `10` — all sitting above a packed lower chamber of red, blue, green, yellow, and orange blocks. Drain the lower blocks first to let the two `3` chambers collapse quickly, then use the freed upper space for the longer `10` reduction.
landmarks: Block Out Level 46 has three boss chambers across the upper half — two smaller ones at `3` each and a larger one at `10` — all sitting above a packed lower chamber of red, blue, green, yellow, and orange blocks.
Drain the lower blocks first to let the two `3` chambers collapse quickly, then use the freed upper space for the longer `10` reduction.
The board mixes Red, Blue, Green and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The two `3` chambers are fast wins — if they are still up when you start the `10`, you are working the wrong part of the board.
Drain the lower colored blocks before any boss chamber.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Thin the lower colored blocks toward the bottom exits to start reducing all three boss counters.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Let the two `3`-count chambers collapse as the lower space opens.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the `10` chamber parked until the `3`s are both gone.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the freed upper space to accelerate the `10` reduction.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Sort the remaining colored blocks through the side exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the late red, blue, and yellow pieces from the lower chamber.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last chamber fragments and side cleanup.

failurePoints: Splitting effort between all three chambers from the start — the `10` needs far more room than the `3`s, so the quick wins should go first.
Not draining the lower colored blocks before attacking the boss chambers, which leaves no room for the bosses to collapse into.
